title: ChargePoint Home Flex ssh Hard-coded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-131816)
description: CVE-2026-131816 is a medium severity vulnerability in ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. It involves hard-coded credentials in the SSH service, allowing network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication without needing valid credentials. The SSH service listens on TCP port 22 by default. This flaw enables attackers to gain unauthorized access to affected devices.
